risks.quote: the information provided by Generative AI may not always be reliable or up to date, for example they have been known to commonly ‘hallucinate’ references which do not exist
While Generative AI can be a valuable tool for understanding concepts and exploring ideas, it should never replace your own critical thinking and analysis.
if the dataset has bias within it, it is likely to be transferred to the information generated
For most Generative AI tools, by uploading your work you grant the providers the right to use it as they see fit, and this may include sharing it with other people.

it is important to be aware of copyright laws as they will apply to the content uploaded to the Generative AI interface, the training data used to build the models, and potentially the outputs generated

One key concern is the environmental impact of digital technologies like GenAI, potentially requiring massive amounts of energy consumption and water, as well as emitting high levels of carbon emissions.

responsibilities.quote: Always double-check and verify information obtained from Generative AI tools.
